system.description: Spend two Blood Traits; for one hour, the vampire is immune to overwhelming mundane sensory input (searchlights, gunfire, pepper spray) even while using powers like Heightened Senses, and takes two fewer Traits of wound penalty (full penalty applies once Sensory Shield ends). A Static Fortitude-level Test can reduce Trait penalties from severe environmental hazards. Glowing wounds/orifices impose a two-Trait penalty on Social Challenges against mortals while active.
